summary: Iteration 415 — Comprehensive 17-mode Taxi/VTC verification. Backend pytest 32/33 PASSED, 1 SKIP (driver pre-existing scheduled-cancel suspension from prior iterations). Frontend: 15/17 modes render the [data-testid='ride-choose-page'] panel correctly with no console errors; 'access' renders a different layout (no ride-choose-page testid) and 'electric' bounced to /login due to a session/WebSocket race at the end of the loop. No HTTP 500. All estimate endpoints return positive fares. Notifications are created on booking and on driver status transitions.

minor.issue: Test cleanup via POST /rides/{id}/cancel triggers the passenger moderation counter and produces 403 'Réservations suspendues' on subsequent tests. The famtester demo account brief states the ban is reset, but it re-arms after a few cancellations. Test had to bypass by mass-updating ride status directly in MongoDB. Suggest an admin/reset endpoint for the demo account, or exclude demo accounts from moderation.

Path does NOT exist (404). Actual airport endpoints are /api/flights/airports and /api/phase2/airports — the brief referenced /api/rides/airports which is wrong. Either add an alias on the rides router or update docs.
Hard-capped at 50 items with no pagination/since cursor → cannot detect notification growth for a busy user. Suggest returning {items, count, last_at} or supporting ?since=<ts>.

ui_bugs.issue: Page does NOT expose [data-testid='ride-choose-page'] for mode=access. Likely a redirect/alternate layout for PMR. Either render the standard panel with the testid, or document the /ferry redirect behaviour referenced in the brief.

Repeated WebSocket reconnects to /ws and /api/ws/call_user_<id> hit HTTP 429 (rate-limited handshake). After ~16 successive /course?mode=X navigations the session was lost and the next page rendered /login. Tighten the WS reconnect backoff and/or relax the proxy 429 budget.

backend.standard_ride_creates_and_notification: PASSED — POST /api/rides (sb,cash) → 200/pending and /api/push/list contains a 'Recherche…/Réservation/course/chauffeur' notification.
backend.pool_ride_create: PASSED — POST /api/rides with pool_enabled=true creates a pool ride.
backend.scheduled_ok_and_double_book_409: PASSED — scheduled_at=now+2h OK; second within 30min → HTTP 409.
backend.corporate_my: PASSED — GET /api/corporate/my returned a valid response (200 or 404 acceptable when no account).
backend.instant_ride_lifecycle_and_notifications: PASSED — client creates instant ride, driver accepts, transition to 'arriving' OK; 'in_progress' is OTP-gated (expected behaviour, not a bug); new notification appears in /api/push/list (timestamp changed).
backend.scheduled_arriving_blocked_outside_windo: SKIPPED — driver jean.dupont is currently under 'Réservations planifiées suspendues' from prior iterations; cannot accept scheduled rides. Not a code defect; pre-existing driver moderation state.

frontend.login_via_email: PASSED — famtester@demo.sb / FamTest123! logs in and lands on /home.
frontend.17_modes_load: 15/17 PASSED with [data-testid='ride-choose-page'] visible and zero console errors: standard, pool, rental, buddy_driver, bidding, intercity, book_later, moto, moto_rental, airport, pets, book_for_someone, tuktuk, assist, corporate. ISSUES: 'access' renders without the ride-choose-page testid; 'electric' bounced to /login at the end of the loop (session/WS race after 16 successive navigations).
frontend.console_errors: Only WebSocket 429 handshake errors observed (rate-limit on /ws and /api/ws/call_user_<id>) — no JS exceptions, no /api/push/list errors.

action_items: BACKEND: Add an admin/dev endpoint to reset moderation_state for demo accounts (famtester, etc.) OR exclude @demo.sb accounts from the cancellation counter — current setup causes flaky bans during normal test runs.
BACKEND: Add an alias GET /api/rides/airports → /api/flights/airports, or correct the public doc. The brief explicitly references /api/rides/airports which 404s today.
BACKEND: /api/push/list — return pagination metadata (items + total + last_at) or support a ?since=<iso> filter; current hard cap of 50 makes change-detection unreliable for busy users.

FRONTEND: For mode=access, render the standard <RideChoosePage> shell (with [data-testid='ride-choose-page']) before any downstream redirect to /ferry, so the page is discoverable and testable; OR document the redirect.

FRONTEND/WS: Add exponential backoff and circuit-breaker for /ws + /api/ws/call_user_<id> reconnect to avoid the cascade of 429 handshake errors that eventually invalidate the session — this is what bumped /course?mode=electric back to /login at the end of the test loop.
DRIVER MODERATION: jean.dupont@demo.sb is currently under a scheduled-rides suspension that blocks acceptance of all scheduled rides; reset or shorten this for demo drivers.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/rides.py:923 — POST /api/rides reuses the same 'no_drivers_available' branch for instant + bidding requests. Bidding rides ought to be created in 'bidding' status even without an online driver (auction model). Today they are blocked.

routes/rides.py:451 — anti_double_booking_min defaults to a 30-min window centered on scheduled_at. Combined with the 60-min min_advance, a passenger booking back-to-back rides within an hour gets a 409 even for legitimate consecutive trips. Consider widening only on the past side, not the future.
routes/push_web.py:92 — list_notifications returns a bare list (no envelope, no count). Frontend should not rely on .items shape; clean up the response contract.
core/router_groups: rides router has NO /airports endpoint despite the public doc referencing it. Either add the route or update the doc.
RideChoosePage mode=access does not expose data-testid='ride-choose-page' — breaks testability.
test_credentials: Client famtester@demo.sb / FamTest123! (resets needed every run), Driver jean.dupont@demo.sb / Driver123! (currently under scheduled-rides suspension).
seed_data_creation: None. Tests use direct MongoDB updates to clear pending rides and moderation_state for famtester at setUp/tearDown.

Famtester moderation must be reset (db.moderation_state) before cancel-heavy tests, or use the direct-DB cleanup pattern in test_iter415_all_taxi_modes.py::_reset_passenger_moderation_and_pending. Driver jean.dupont is under planned-rides suspension — clear db.driver_release_state for him before re-running the scheduled-arriving-window test.
rca of the issue: 1) 'access' mode missing ride-choose-page testid: RideChoosePage early-returns/redirects for ride_type='accessible' before mounting the standard layout. 2) /course?mode=electric bouncing to /login: cumulative WebSocket 429 handshake failures (no backoff) eventually cause the auth refresh path to drop the cookie. 3) scheduled-window test skipped because driver-side suspension is still active from iterations 411–414 cancel/release cycles.
